description: React component for listing and managing report templates, including fetching data, downloading attachments, and UI interactions.

methods.name: deleteTemplate
methods.description: Handles deletion of a report template by invoking mutation.

methods.name: onReportTemplateFormSaved
methods.description: Refetches templates and closes the add report template dialog.

methods.description: Downloads a report attachment by creating a temporary link.

methods.name: safeResolveMime
methods.description: Resolves MIME type to a human-readable name, with error handling.
